build_DeticFastRCNNOutputLayers: build a DeticFastRCNNOutputLayers model with zero-shot classifier and federated loss for open-vocabulary detection
create_from_config: create DeticFastRCNNOutputLayers from a Detectron2 config with zero-shot and fed loss options enabled
run_losses_computation: run the losses method to compute classification and box regression losses for ROI proposals
test_sigmoid_cross_entropy_loss: test the sigmoid cross entropy loss with federated loss weighting and zero category ignoring
review_softmax_cross_entropy_loss: review the softmax cross entropy loss method with fed loss and zero category weight support
run_inference: run fast R-CNN inference on proposals with optional proposal score multiplication and NMS
test_box_reg_loss: test the box regression loss supporting smooth L1 and GIoU loss types with custom background index
review_image_label_losses: review the image label losses method supporting wsod, max score, max size, and caption loss strategies
run_forward: run the forward pass to compute class scores and proposal deltas with optional classifier info
test_put_label_distribution: test the put_label_distribution function to record class label histogram stats to event storage
